name: Bootstrap with python Debian/Ubuntu
review_question: Should this executable Ansible task be considered excessively large and in need of decomposition?
reviewer_1_reason: 'Bootstrap with python Debian/Ubuntu' chains 'apt update && apt install python3.5; apt install python3' inside one raw string -- two independent package installs that each map to their own apt task, collapsed into one raw block per the rule 8 positive pattern.

     2: - gather_facts: False

     4:   ############## To avoid some issues with cloud-init and unattended upgrades ###############
     5:     - name: Avoid unattended upgrades
     6:       raw: |
     7:         sudo touch /var/lib/apt/periodic/upgrade-stamp; \
     8:         sudo touch /var/lib/apt/periodic/update-stamp; \
     9:         sudo touch /var/lib/apt/periodic/download-upgradeable-stamp;

    11:       changed_when: false
    12: 
    13:     - name: Wait for the VM to boot
    14:       raw: systemctl is-system-running --wait
    15:       ignore_errors: yes
    16:       changed_when: false
    17: 
    18:     # Some OSs does not have python by default
    19:     - name: Check Python2 is installed
    20:       raw: python2 -c 'import sys; print(sys.version_info[1])'
    21:       ignore_errors: yes
    22:       register: python2_version
    23:       changed_when: false
    24: 
    25:     - name: Check Python3 is installed
    26:       raw: python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.version_info[1])'
    27:       ignore_errors: yes
    28:       register: python3_version
    29:       changed_when: false

    63:       become: yes
    64:       ignore_errors: yes
